clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Kil'hala weaves dryad hair into enchanted cloth for spellcasters. The finished garment marks the end of his specialized work in the Barrens.

At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Kil'hala weaves nether-lace from the locks of laughing sisters. The dryads live in Ashenvale, and their hair is harvested for this work. Kil'hala binds the woodland enchantment in those rare, magically resonant locks into cloth that is comfortable and durable.

Kil'hala wants more than fine work from his trade. He hopes to win favor with Deino, a respected troll mage who lives in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. By making exceptional garb for aspiring practitioners, he hopes to earn and keep Deino's good graces.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your nether-lace, friend. It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.
Enjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. She is a mage on whose good side I wish to stay...
